page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; no margin notes; running head at top; page number at top left; catchword at bottom right.
page.running_head: De agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.l: agro jam sint, non sint obnoxiae stapulae ju-
ri, easque emere, vendere, commutare inter
se agrariis liceat: exceptis equis, hinnulis,
bubus, vaccis, trimestre longiusve tempus
in agro pastis, qui in agro natis accenseri
& fort[?] oppidani juri subjecti esse debent. In
agro nata & stapulae subjecta non alia cense-
ri debent quàm haec: butyrum, caseus, equi,
pulli, boves, vaccae, triticum, secale, hor-
deum, avena, far: atque haec omninò, ni an-
tè promercalia Groningæ[?] fuerint, distrahe-
re in agro licitum non sit. Sub iis, quae in
usum rei familiaris vendere & emere licet,
etiam eu comprehendantur, quae lanij, pisto-
res, propolae, aut institores in usum rei suae
in agro coëmunt, ut minutim rursum ven-
dant. Agrarius peregrino vendens res suas
fori juri subjectas immunis à poena sit, nisi
constiterit, scisse, peregrinum esse, quo cum
contraxit. Hovetmanni ab oppidanis electi,
ab Ordinibus totius provinciae potestatem
judicandi accipiant, & iis, ac apud eos
sacramento se obligent ex formâ solenni, in
sententia ascripta. Ante hoc sacramentum
praestitum Hovetmanni pro Hovetmannis
non habeantur, & acta eorum velut non

page.notes: Catchword "acta" is set in italic and sits at the lower right, after the last line. The word "fort" at the end of a line appears to be an abbreviation, possibly "fortè"; the mark is uncertain. "Groningæ" is uncertain: the ending is hard to read in the scan. "ascripta" is read from a blurred word and may be "adscripta". Short-s spellings (e.g. "scisse", "Fris.") follow the rule for plain s. The running head "Amas." is read from "Amaf.". A small stain and a digitiser watermark at the lower right are ignored.
